$comment: The usage analytics event format (PEN-137), written from packages/core/src/analytics by packages/core/test/analytics-contract.test.ts, which also checks it. Android records events in this format and checks them as validate.ts does: a name must be in `catalogue` under its kind, and each prop one of `props` for its kind (`enum`: one of `values`; `bool`; `count`: one of `countBuckets`; `duration`: one of `durationBuckets`; `keys`: matches `patterns.keys`; `flags`: at most `maxFlags` names, each one of `cliFlags`; `setting`: a boolean, a whole number 0 to `maxSettingNumber`, a count bucket, or one of the words `settingValues` lists for the event name (a setting not listed takes no word); `screen`: a name in `catalogue.screen`; `length`: a whole number, a multiple of 10, 0 to `maxLength`; `fraction`: a number from 0 to 1 that is a whole number of hundredths). An event whose `kind.name` is a key of `nameProps` takes the props of that entry instead of those of its kind, and no other name of the kind takes them. A kind listed in `kindClients` comes only from those clients. A `scroll` event is recorded `scroll.settleMs` after its area stops moving, at most one per area every `scroll.minGapMs` (scroll-v1.json pins the rules). Session detail (PEN-177): `ref` matches `patterns.ref` (16 hex characters, the first of hex(HMAC-SHA256(the key’s 32 bytes, type + ":" + id)), `refVectors` pinning it); `index` is a whole number 0 to `detail.maxIndex`; `chars` a whole number 0 to `detail.maxChars`; `shape` a list of at most `detail.maxShapeTokens` tokens, each matching `patterns.block` with a length of at most `detail.maxChars`, and at most `detail.maxShapeBytes` as JSON. `clamp` holds clampUsage’s cases ([type, value, clamped]), `propsLine` the viewers’ line for each props object, and `eventCases` events of the new kinds with the problem eventProblem finds (null: valid). No control records a click id in `retiredClickNames`; they stay catalogued. States are stored as their `code`. The catalogue only grows.
